messages.text: What is signal-integrity-to-oscilloscope, and which product-related measurement decisions depend on understanding it?

### Short answer
“signal-integrity-to-oscilloscope” is not defined in the passages as a formal term; the supported meaning is a mapping between high-speed digital signal-integrity validation needs and when an oscilloscope is one of the relevant instrument types, especially for interface test and PDN validation contexts.[2][29]  
### What it means
Signal integrity in the cited high-speed PCB/PCBA context is represented by flows and measurements such as IL / insertion loss, Xtalk / crosstalk, eye diagram, TDR impedance, stackup planning and transmission-line calculation.[17][29]  
Oscilloscopes appear in the validation-challenges context as instruments for Interface Test, alongside BERTs, AWGs and switch matrices.[1][29]  
Oscilloscopes also appear in the Power Distribution Network test block, alongside network analyzers.[1][29]  
The sources explicitly warn that these instrument-type mappings must not be converted into formal product configurations, and they do not provide oscilloscope model, bandwidth, option, standard, fixture or pass/fail details.[2][28]  
### Product-related measurement decisions that depend on understanding it
| Decision | What depends on understanding the SI-to-oscilloscope mapping | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| Whether an oscilloscope is relevant for high-speed interface validation | Interface Test is mapped to scopes, BERTs, AWGs and switch matrices, so choosing a scope versus companion instruments depends on the interface-test measurement role.[1][29] | [1][29] |
| Whether a PDN problem is a scope measurement, a network-analyzer measurement, or both | Power Distribution Network validation is mapped to scopes and network analyzers, so the measurement decision depends on whether the need is treated in the PDN validation block rather than the PCB SI-flow block.[1][29] | [1][29] |
| Whether the task belongs to PCB/PCBA SI flow rather than oscilloscope-only validation | The high-speed PCB/PCBA signal-integrity flow lists IL, Xtalk, eye diagram, TDR impedance, stackup planner and TL calculator, which means not every SI task is stated as an oscilloscope task.[17][29] | [17][29] |
| Whether to use PCB-test solution measurements instead of assuming a scope configuration | R&S PCB test solutions list material measurement, stackup selection, SI modeling/testing, sampling testing and process monitoring, with measurements such as impedance/TDR, DK/DF extraction, IL, roughness, Xtalk, TL modeling and eye diagram.[19][43][46] | [19][43][46] |
| Whether a named R&S product can be quoted for this scope/SI need | The R&S PCB test-solution source does not provide formal R&S product model, option code, license, test frequency, standard, fixture or calibration method, so a product quotation cannot be derived from the SI-to-scope mapping alone.[21][47] | [21][47] |
| Whether VNA/probing/de-embedding is the better product direction for interconnect SI cases | The probing/de-embedding cases describe VNA, probe, mount-kit and de-embedding tools being used for PCB, socket, connector and SoC validation measurement problems, rather than framing those cases as oscilloscope-only decisions.[31][5] | [31][5] |
### Bottom line
Understanding “signal-integrity-to-oscilloscope” prevents treating every signal-integrity need as an oscilloscope purchase; the passages support oscilloscope relevance for interface and PDN validation, while PCB material, stackup, channel and interconnect SI decisions may instead involve TDR, VNA/network analyzer, DK/DF extraction, Delta-L, probes and de-embedding workflows.[1][19][31][46]

- [[HSD PCB image 15]]（來源未標示日期；取得於 2026-09-04）稱常聽到的 [[Low DK]] 是玻纖布材質低介電 / 低延遲的意思。

- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 Loss tangent（Df）或 Dissipation Factor 是 signal 沿 transmission line 傳播時 signal attenuation 的量測。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 dielectric loss 來自 dielectric material 對 electromagnetic wave 的吸收；frequency 增加時，dielectric loss 也成比例增加。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 ultra-low loss materials 的 Df 通常範圍為 0.02 到 0.001；較小的 Df 會造成較低 signal attenuation；[[PCIe]] 等 high speed applications 需要低 Df。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 [[fiberglass weave]] 的 εr 約為 6，[[epoxy]] 的 εr 約為 3；fiber glass laminate 中的 holes 或 openings 會造成 εr 與 Df 差異。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 εr 與 Df 差異會在 signal bandwidth 的不同頻率上造成 transmission media 的 [[return loss]] 或 [[insertion loss]] resonance / anti-resonance。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 εr 通常範圍為 2.5 到 4.5，並隨 frequency 變化；frequency 增加時 εr 下降。

- TDCP is a new measurement introduced in Rel-18。
- TDCP provides CSI information on the relative mobility of the UE and the associated Doppler on the channel with the gNodeB。
- TDCP can be used to adjust configuration parameters such as codebook type or reference signal，以 adapt to channel conditions and ensure robust transmission in high-speed scenarios。

[[R&S CMX500]] 是 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 的 Radio Communication Tester；依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]] Specifications Version 11.00（August 2025），它是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]、NSA、SA、FDD、TDD、FR1/FR2 RF parametric testing、fading propagation conditions 與多種 OBT hardware configurations。

MVG › CMX500 OBT / WaveStudio 整合
依 [[MVG integrates CMX500 OBT into WaveStudio Software Suite, simplifying 5G OTA signaling test processes]]：

- [[MVG]] 已將 [[R&S CMX500 OBT]] 整合進 [[WaveStudio Software Suite]]。
- 使用者可透過 [[MVG]] antenna measurement systems 直接執行 [[5G NR]] 與 [[LTE]] OTA signaling testing。
- 與 [[MVG]] multi-probe measurement systems 搭配時，可在 real-world conditions 下進行 OTA testing。
- 整合後支援 [[5G NR Standalone]]（SA）mode、[[RedCap]] 與 [[LTE]]（FDD & TDD）signaling testing。
- [[Pierre Jurek]] 表示，[[MVG]] 決定支援 different OBT configurations，並正快速擴充到 WiFi technologies，尤其是 [[Wi-Fi 7]] / [[IEEE 802.11be]]。

依 [[MVG OTA test systems now support full WLAN OTA signaling testing alongside cellular coverage with CMX500 OBT from Rohde & Schwarz]]：

- [[MVG]] 已將 full [[WLAN]] signaling test functionality including [[Wi-Fi 7]] of the [[R&S CMX500 OBT]] 整合進 [[WaveStudio Software Suite]]。
- 來源稱此整合讓 manufacturers 可在 single antenna measurement system 中執行 comprehensive 4G、5G 與 [[WLAN]] [[OTA testing]]。
- [[WaveStudio Software Suite]] 整合 full Wi‑Fi（[[IEEE 802.11]] a/b/g/n/ac/ax/be）access point and station testing functionality。
- Software now supports [[5G NR Non-Standalone]]（[[EN-DC]]）testing with the [[R&S CMX500]]。
- [[MVG]] multiprobe measurement systems 被描述為 fully support Wi‑Fi and cellular standards，包括 [[5G NR Standalone]]（SA）、[[5G NR Non-Standalone]]（EN-DC）、[[RedCap]] 與 [[LTE]]（FDD & TDD），all within a single tester。

NR sample rate › Sample rate 與 maximum bandwidth
來源列出：

| Sample rate | Maximum bandwidth | Sample-rate reduction N | Samples per 1 ms subframe | Ts |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 30.72 MS/s | 25 MHz | 64 | 30720 | 32.552 ns |
| 61.44 MS/s | 50 MHz | 32 | 61440 | 16.276 ns |
| 122.88 MS/s | 100 MHz | 16 | 122880 | 8.138 ns |
| 245.76 MS/s | 200 MHz | 8 | 245760 | 4.069 ns |
| 491.52 MS/s | 400 MHz | 4 | 491520 | 2.035 ns |
| 983.04 MS/s | 800 MHz | 2 | 983040 | 1.017 ns |
| 1966.08 MS/s | 1600 MHz | 1 | 1966080 | 0.509 ns |

同一來源也說：

- Samples rates above 491.52 MS/s are currently unrealistic, not really needed and ignored for now。
- Lowest sample rate 30.72 MS/s was chosen to reduce development effort。
- 30.72 MS/s is also the standard sample rate of LTE。
- All bandwidths below approximately 25 MHz can use 30.72 MS/s。

Blackwell GPU › 來源中的說法
- [[AI Server PCB test image 28]]（來源未標示日期；取得於 2026-09-04）在 [[GB200 Bianca Board]] 上標示 **2 × blackwell gpu**。
- [[AI Server PCB test image 28]]（來源未標示日期；取得於 2026-09-04）把兩個 **blackwell gpu** 描述為上半部左右兩個大型方塊。
- [[AI Server PCB test image 28]]（來源未標示日期；取得於 2026-09-04）同一張圖另標示 [[Grace CPU]]、[[LPDDR5X]]、[[NVLink5 Connector]] 與多種電源 / I/O / 互連連接器。
- [[AI Server PCB test image 29]]（來源未標示日期；取得於 2026-09-04）在 [[GB300 Reference Board]] 上半部標示 **4 個 blackwell gpu** 方塊，左右各 2 個。
- [[AI Server PCB test image 29]]（來源未標示日期；取得於 2026-09-04）描述每兩個 GPU 下方各有一組 [[LPDDR5X LPCAMM Modules]] 與 1 個 [[Grace CPU]]；整體可看成左半與右半各 2 個 Blackwell GPU、1 個 Grace CPU、2 個 LPDDR5X LPCAMM Modules。
- [[AI Server PCB test image 29]]（來源未標示日期；取得於 2026-09-04）同一張圖另標示 [[NVLink Connector]]、[[CX-8]]、[[CMOS Battery]]、[[HMC]]、[[SXM7 Puck]]、[[MCIO x16]] 與 [[DensLink connector]]。
- [[HBM-CXL memory pooling in AI Server image 4]]（來源未標示日期；取得於 2026-09-04）在 [[NVIDIA HGX B300 Baseboard]] 區塊中標示 **NVIDIA Blackwell Ultra SXM**，共 8 個方塊。
- [[HBM-CXL memory pooling in AI Server image 4]]（來源未標示日期；取得於 2026-09-04）同一區塊還標示 8 個 [[NVIDIA ConnectX-8 SuperNIC]]、8 個 [[OSFP]] 與 **8 x 800 Gb/s OSFP InfiniBand XDR / Dual 400 Gb/s Ethernet GPU networking ports**。

Normal Uplink carrier › 在 SUL RACH procedure 中的角色
依 [[SUL RACH procedure]]：

- 若 Random Access carrier explicitly signalled，UE selects the signalled carrier。
- 若沒有 explicitly signalled，且 configured [[Supplementary Uplink]] 條件與 `rsrp-ThresholdSSB-SUL` threshold 使 UE 選擇 SUL，則使用 [[SUL carrier]]。
- 否則 UE selects [[Normal Uplink carrier]]。

R&S CMX500 › NR FR1
依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]，R&S CMX-KM600 是 frequency range 1 對 NR uplink signals 執行任何 TX tests 的必要 option。NR FR1 uplink measurements 包含 multi-evaluation、PRACH、SRS、TPC measurement。Multi-evaluation 支援 NR channel bandwidth **3 MHz 到 100 MHz**，可分析 FDD 與 TDD signals、NR standalone signals 與 intraband contiguous EN-DC signals。

依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]]，R&S CMX-KM600 option 的 5G NR analyzer 條件為 FR1、SCS 30 kHz、16QAM、temperature range +15 °C to +35 °C；input level –25 dBm to –10 dBm RMS、bandwidth 100 MHz 時 EVM **< 0.5 %**。Frequency measurement uncertainty：**< 20 Hz + drift of timebase**；相對於同一台 CMX500 device 的 downlink signal 進行 frequency error measurements 時，uncertainty 符合 [[3GPP TS 38.521-1]] V18.5.0。

R&S CMX-KW601 option 的 5G NR generator 條件：5G NR PDSCH、full allocation、SCS 30 kHz / 60 kHz、modulation 64QAM、PAR 11.8 dB、temperature +15 °C to +35 °C；ports RF Com 1、RF Com 2、RF Out 1 to RF Out 4；output level –5 dBm、bandwidth 100 MHz 時 EVM **< 0.5 %**。

R&S CONTEST › Test system selection and operation
依 [[RS_TS8980FTA_PRE_Series_SystemManual_en_63]]：

- 在 [[R&S CONTEST]] > Test System > Select Test System 選擇 test system。
- 可依不同 system components 設定 filters，只列出 subset of suitable configurations。
- Filter categories 包含 Test Category、R&S CONTEST Host、Combiners、CMW Setup、CMX Setup 與 Anechoic Chambers。
- Test Category 可選 RF、RRM 等 test case category。
- R&S CONTEST Host 可選 software installed location，例如 System Controller。
- CMW Setup 可描述 [[R&S CMW500]] environment，例如 [[R&S CMWflexx]]。
- CMX Setup 可描述 [[R&S CMX500]] environment，例如 Single CMX500。
- Anechoic Chambers filter 可選 chamber，例如 [[R&S ATS1800C]]。
- 若 test system 未列出，可將 Include Experimental Test Systems 設為 ON 顯示更多 supported test systems。
- 若知道 test system name 或部分名稱，可使用 full text search。
- 最後需在 Hardware Configuration table 中選擇並 enable devices。

UE channel bandwidth › 來源中的 bandwidth 摘要
[[Frequency Ranges, Bands and Bandwidth]] 的 bandwidth 段落標題為：

- `UE channel bandwidths : Maximum number of resource blocks and subcarriers and required FFT size`
- 欄位標示包含 `maxRB : maxSC (NFFT)` 與 `Bandwidth [Sample Rate]`。

來源 raw 可辨識的 bandwidth / sample rate 欄位包括：

| Bandwidth | Sample rate 標示 |
|---|---:|
| <= 25 MHz | 30.72 MS/s |
| 30..50 MHz | 61.44 MS/s |
| 50 MHz | 61.44 MS/s * |
| 60..100 MHz | 122.88 MS/s |
| 100 MHz | 122.88 MS/s |
| 200 MHz | 245.76 MS/s |
| 400 MHz | 491.52 MS/s |
| 800 MHz | 983.04 MS/s ** |
| 1600 MHz | 1966.08 MS/s ** |
| 2000 MHz | 1966.08 MS/s ** |

來源註記：

- `* sample rate 61.44 MS/s not supported by IF-Unit => use 122.88 MS/s instead`
- `** Bandwidth >400 MHz and µ>4 not yet planned`

Grace CPU › 未決事項
- [[AI Server PCB test image 28]] 未標示日期、年份、季度或資料期間。
- [[AI Server PCB test image 28]] 未提供 **grace cpu** 的完整產品名稱、型號、版本、規格或供應商聲明。
- [[AI Server PCB test image 28]] 未說明 **grace cpu** 與 [[LPDDR5X]]、[[Blackwell GPU]]、[[NVLink5 Connector]] 或 [[Grace-Grace C2C Connector]] 的實際連線拓撲或電氣規格。
- [[AI Server PCB test image 29]] 未標示日期、年份、季度或資料期間。
- [[AI Server PCB test image 29]] 未提供 **grace cpu** 的完整產品名稱、型號、版本、規格或供應商聲明。
- [[AI Server PCB test image 29]] 未說明 **grace cpu** 與 [[LPDDR5X LPCAMM Modules]]、[[Blackwell GPU]]、[[NVLink Connector]]、[[CX-8]]、[[MCIO x16]] 或 [[DensLink connector]] 的實際連線拓撲或電氣規格。
- [[AI Server PCB test image 29]] 未說明 [[GB300 Reference Board]] 是否為設計示意、實際產品板卡、工程樣品、拆解圖、推測圖或量產板。

Normal Uplink carrier › 與 PUCCH common resource 的關係
來源提出一個 configuration validation 線索：

- 若 configured SUL 且 [[RSRP]] < `rsrp-ThresholdSSB-SUL`，RACH on [[SUL carrier]] is selected。
- 若 `pucch-ResourceCommon` configured only on NUL，來源判斷 this configuration should be rejected。

這表示在 initial SUL RACH context 中，僅在 NUL 配置 common PUCCH resource 可能與 Msg4 HARQ-ACK on target carrier 的要求不一致。來源未說明此判斷的 normative 層級。

HBM › 未決事項
- [[IO Serdes in AI ASIC-TPU-Chiplet image 3]] 未標示日期、年份、季度或資料期間。
- [[IO Serdes in AI ASIC-TPU-Chiplet image 3]] 未標示 HBM 代際、容量、堆疊數、頻寬、介面、數量口徑或供應商。
- [[IO Serdes in AI ASIC-TPU-Chiplet image 3]] 未標示 HBM 與 XPU 的互連技術或封裝技術名稱。
- [[IO Serdes in AI ASIC-TPU-Chiplet image]] 未標示日期、年份、季度或資料期間。
- [[IO Serdes in AI ASIC-TPU-Chiplet image]] 未標示 **4x more HBMs** 的比較基準、HBM 顆數、HBM 代際、容量或頻寬。
- [[IO Serdes in AI ASIC-TPU-Chiplet image]] 未標示 HBM 與 [[NuLink]]、[[HBI]]、[[D2D]] 的完整介面規格。

Receiver Pre-adder
[[Receiver Pre-adder]] 是 [[Antenna Switching and Receiver Pre-adder_Selection for Multi-port SRS]] 中描述的 receiver-side processing 概念：在 received streams 進入 receiver chains 前，先對特定 streams 做 addition 或 selection，以配合有限或指定數量的 receiver chains。

UE channel bandwidth
[[UE channel bandwidth]] 是 5G NR UE 在特定 [[Subcarrier Spacing]] 與 frequency range 下使用的 channel bandwidth 配置；[[Frequency Ranges, Bands and Bandwidth]] 將它連到 maximum number of resource blocks、subcarriers、required FFT size 與 sample rate。

Grace CPU › 可追溯範圍
- 本頁只記錄 [[AI Server PCB test image 28]] 與 [[AI Server PCB test image 29]] 中 **grace cpu** 的圖上文字與數量標示。
- 本頁不自行補全 Grace CPU 的供應商、完整型號、SKU、核心數、記憶體容量、功耗、封裝、出貨狀態或客戶。
- 本頁不把 [[AI Server PCB test image 28]] 或 [[AI Server PCB test image 29]] 的板卡示意圖解讀為供應鏈、合約、採購、量產或出貨證據。
- 本頁不把 **Grace-Grace C2C Connector** 的存在推論為特定雙 CPU 拓撲、頻寬或產品配置；[[AI Server PCB test image 28]] 只提供圖上標示。
- [[AI Server PCB test image 28]] 標示 1 個 **grace cpu**，[[AI Server PCB test image 29]] 標示 2 個 **grace cpu**；兩者對應不同板卡 / 圖上標題，不構成矛盾。

PUSCH on SUL
[[PUSCH on SUL]] 是 [[Supplementary Uplink]] 場景中，UE 在 [[SUL carrier]] 或 [[Normal Uplink carrier]] 上傳送 [[PUSCH]] 的配置與動態選擇機制。

HBM › 使用限制
- [[IO Serdes in AI ASIC-TPU-Chiplet image 3]] 未標示 HBM 代際，例如 HBM2e、HBM3、HBM3e 或 HBM4。
- [[IO Serdes in AI ASIC-TPU-Chiplet image 3]] 未標示 HBM 容量、堆疊數、頻寬、介面寬度、供應商、數量口徑或測試條件。
- [[IO Serdes in AI ASIC-TPU-Chiplet image]] 未標示 HBM 代際、容量、頻寬、供應商、顆數基準或測試條件。
- [[IO Serdes in AI ASIC-TPU-Chiplet image]] 的 **4x more HBMs** 是圖上宣稱；來源未說明比較基準，因此不能直接寫成特定產品 HBM 顆數增加四倍。
- 本頁不把圖中的 HBM 模組數量改寫成實際產品規格或量產配置。
- 本頁不因 HBM 與 XPU / ASIC 在圖上接近，就推論特定 [[Interposer]]、[[CoWoS]]、[[EMIB]]、[[Foveros]]、[[2.5D 3D 封裝]] 或 [[3D IC]] 技術。

Receiver Pre-adder › Receiver chains 數量
依 [[Antenna Switching and Receiver Pre-adder_Selection for Multi-port SRS]] 的 Figure 5 說明：

- 對 4 個 receive streams，允許使用 1、2 或 4 條 receiver chains。
- 來源顯示使用 1 和 2 條 receiver chains 的 cases。
- 若使用 4 條 receiver chains，所有 received streams 會 directly mapped to the receiver chains，也就是 no selection or addition is done。

UE channel bandwidth › 使用限制
- 本頁依 [[Frequency Ranges, Bands and Bandwidth]] 建立；來源是 lossy markdown derivative，表格排版明顯破碎。
- `IF-Unit` 未展開為具體產品、模組或版本，不可推論到特定 [[Rohde & Schwarz GmbH & Co KG]] 儀器。
- `Bandwidth >400 MHz and µ>4 not yet planned` 未標示規劃主體，不能直接當成 3GPP normative rule。
- 若要引用完整 maxRB、maxSC、NFFT 或 sample rate 對應，需回查原始 PDF 或正式 [[3GPP TS 38.101-1]] / [[3GPP TS 38.101-2]]。

Grace CPU › 相關來源
- [[AI Server PCB test image 28]] — 未標示日期、Source 標示為 SemiAnalysis 的 GB200 Bianca Board 板卡配置示意圖。
- [[AI Server PCB test image 29]] — 未標示日期的 GB300 Reference Board 硬體主機板 / 參考板配置示意圖。

PUSCH on SUL › 使用限制
- 來源未提供 formal DCI field table 或 [[3GPP TS 38.212]] exact wording。
- 來源未標示 [[3GPP TS 38.214]] / [[3GPP TS 38.213]] 的 PUSCH scheduling 條文。
- 既有 [[UL-SUL indicator]] 頁保存 TC-RNTI DCI0_0 context 中 indicator reserved 的說法；本頁的 DCI0_0 / 0_1 / 0_2 dynamic switching 目前視為不同 context，需正式規格確認。

HBM › 來源中的說法
- [[IO Serdes in AI ASIC-TPU-Chiplet image 3]]（來源未標示日期；取得於 2026-09-04）圖上多個橘色模組標示為 **HBM**。
- [[IO Serdes in AI ASIC-TPU-Chiplet image 3]]（來源未標示日期；取得於 2026-09-04）文字整理指出 **HBM** 在圖中重複出現多次。
- [[IO Serdes in AI ASIC-TPU-Chiplet image 3]]（來源未標示日期；取得於 2026-09-04）描述 HBM 模組環繞或緊鄰中央 [[XPU]]，並將其定性解讀為高頻寬記憶體與運算晶片緊密整合的圖像表達。
- [[IO Serdes in AI ASIC-TPU-Chiplet image 3]]（來源未標示日期；取得於 2026-09-04）同一圖中還標示 [[SerDes]] 與 [[Optical I-O]]，但沒有明確畫出連線。
- [[IO Serdes in AI ASIC-TPU-Chiplet image]]（來源未標示日期；取得於 2026-09-04）左上 **AI ASIC with Silicon Interposer** 圖中標示 **HBM** 與 **Base Die**，並與 [[ASIC]]、[[HBI]]、[[Silicon Interposer]]、[[Organic Substrate]] 同圖出現。
- [[IO Serdes in AI ASIC-TPU-Chiplet image]]（來源未標示日期；取得於 2026-09-04）右上 **AI ASIC with NuLink → 4x more HBMs → Star-Bus (Tree) Topology** 圖中標示 **HBM** 與 **FinFET Base Die**，並以 [[NuLink]] 連到 [[ASIC]]。
- [[IO Serdes in AI ASIC-TPU-Chiplet image]]（來源未標示日期；取得於 2026-09-04）中下大型拓樸圖在中央多顆 [[ASIC]] 上下排列大量 **HBM**，並多次標示 [[NuLink]]。
- [[IO Serdes in AI ASIC-TPU-Chiplet image]]（來源未標示日期；取得於 2026-09-04）頁尾寫 **HBM = High-Bandwidth Memory**。

RoBAT
[[RoBAT]] 是 [[HSD Cable test]] 中以 `robattest.com` 外部連結出現的 signal integrity test products / cable cartridge testing 相關名稱；本次來源未擷取 RoBAT 網站正文。

Receiver Pre-adder › 定義
依 [[Antenna Switching and Receiver Pre-adder_Selection for Multi-port SRS]]：

- 在 receiver side（來源文字：on CMX），not all received streams have to be necessarily further processed in separate receiver chains。
- Some of the received streams may be selected or added before mapping them to the receiver chains。
- 這在 limited number of receiver chains are available 或 desired to be used 時有用。

來源同時以 [[SRS antenna switching]] / multi-port [[SRS]] 為主要 use case，討論 UE 端 logical-to-physical port mapping 與 receiver 端 pre-adder / selection 的關係。

GNSS record replay › 來源列出的 recorder / replay capability
- Recording unit with up to three bands。
- Bandwidth up to 68 MHz。
- Intermediate frequency。
- Sampling rate up to 81 MHz。
- Bit width up to 2x8 bit complex。
- Replay with the same unit。

Kuiper UT 測試流程 › OTA 電波暗室配置
Slide 7 列出 OTA 電波暗室資訊：

- 核心設備：3 × 3 × 3 m 暗室、多探頭陣列 48–192 個、VNA 與信號分析儀。
- 校準步驟：背景扣除、元素 A/P 校準、波束表生成。
- 輸出品質：增益誤差 < 0.5 dB、指向誤差 < 0.5°、模式完整性。

此段可連到 [[Phased Array OTA testing]]、[[相控陣列天線]]與 [[低軌衛星終端設備檢測]]，但來源未提供儀器型號、校準標準或 measurement uncertainty。

Radiated Spurious Emissions
[[Radiated Spurious Emissions]]（RSE）是無線裝置在載波與必要頻寬之外，以輻射方式發出的 unwanted emissions 測試項目；本 vault 目前主要由 [[Regulatory test for wireless devices with cellular technology]] 與 [[RSE Test System TS8996 (1)]] 支撐。

R&S CMX-KA401
[[R&S CMX-KA401]] 是 [[R&S CMX500]] 的 advanced audio measurement / generator and playback software option；[[CMX_Configuration_Guide_Audio-Testing]] 中將它列為 OTT voice quality、customer WAV injection、VoIP wave injection、E2E audio delay、IP streaming、playback/record 與 non-realtime IMS 等 scope 的 conditional option。

RoBAT › 來源中的說法
- [[HSD Cable test]]（路徑含 2026-7-22；converted 2026-09-17）列出 `https://robattest.com/`。
- [[HSD Cable test]]（路徑含 2026-7-22；converted 2026-09-17）的連結文字為 RoBAT Leading Edge Signal Integrity Test Products。

### Short answer
“signal-integrity-to-oscilloscope” is not defined in the passages as a formal term; the supported meaning is a mapping between high-speed digital signal-integrity validation needs and when an oscilloscope is one of the relevant instrument types, especially for interface test and PDN validation contexts.[2][29]  
### What it means
Signal integrity in the cited high-speed PCB/PCBA context is represented by flows and measurements such as IL / insertion loss, Xtalk / crosstalk, eye diagram, TDR impedance, stackup planning and transmission-line calculation.[17][29]  
Oscilloscopes appear in the validation-challenges context as instruments for Interface Test, alongside BERTs, AWGs and switch matrices.[1][29]  
Oscilloscopes also appear in the Power Distribution Network test block, alongside network analyzers.[1][29]  
The sources explicitly warn that these instrument-type mappings must not be converted into formal product configurations, and they do not provide oscilloscope model, bandwidth, option, standard, fixture or pass/fail details.[2][28]  
### Product-related measurement decisions that depend on understanding it
| Decision | What depends on understanding the SI-to-oscilloscope mapping | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| Whether an oscilloscope is relevant for high-speed interface validation | Interface Test is mapped to scopes, BERTs, AWGs and switch matrices, so choosing a scope versus companion instruments depends on the interface-test measurement role.[1][29] | [1][29] |
| Whether a PDN problem is a scope measurement, a network-analyzer measurement, or both | Power Distribution Network validation is mapped to scopes and network analyzers, so the measurement decision depends on whether the need is treated in the PDN validation block rather than the PCB SI-flow block.[1][29] | [1][29] |
| Whether the task belongs to PCB/PCBA SI flow rather than oscilloscope-only validation | The high-speed PCB/PCBA signal-integrity flow lists IL, Xtalk, eye diagram, TDR impedance, stackup planner and TL calculator, which means not every SI task is stated as an oscilloscope task.[17][29] | [17][29] |
| Whether to use PCB-test solution measurements instead of assuming a scope configuration | R&S PCB test solutions list material measurement, stackup selection, SI modeling/testing, sampling testing and process monitoring, with measurements such as impedance/TDR, DK/DF extraction, IL, roughness, Xtalk, TL modeling and eye diagram.[19][43][46] | [19][43][46] |
| Whether a named R&S product can be quoted for this scope/SI need | The R&S PCB test-solution source does not provide formal R&S product model, option code, license, test frequency, standard, fixture or calibration method, so a product quotation cannot be derived from the SI-to-scope mapping alone.[21][47] | [21][47] |
| Whether VNA/probing/de-embedding is the better product direction for interconnect SI cases | The probing/de-embedding cases describe VNA, probe, mount-kit and de-embedding tools being used for PCB, socket, connector and SoC validation measurement problems, rather than framing those cases as oscilloscope-only decisions.[31][5] | [31][5] |
### Bottom line
Understanding “signal-integrity-to-oscilloscope” prevents treating every signal-integrity need as an oscilloscope purchase; the passages support oscilloscope relevance for interface and PDN validation, while PCB material, stackup, channel and interconnect SI decisions may instead involve TDR, VNA/network analyzer, DK/DF extraction, Delta-L, probes and de-embedding workflows.[1][19][31][46]
